title: nvidia-smi limited field query (driver-bundled tool; no serial/UUID fields requested)

output: name, pci.bus_id, pci.device_id, pci.sub_device_id, driver_version, vbios_version, memory.total [MiB], display_mode, display_active, pstate, driver_model.current, pcie.link.gen.max, pcie.link.width.max
